statements: The shortest war in history was between Britain and Zanzibar on August 27, 1896, and lasted only 38 minutes.
The longest mountain range in the world is the Mid-Ocean Ridge, which stretches for over 65,000 kilometers (40,000 miles) around the globe.
The Great Fire of London in 1666 destroyed over 80% of the city and led to the creation of the London Building Act, which required all buildings to be made of stone and have a tiled roof.
